achado: epiglote acentuadamente edemaciada e espessada, arredondada — sinal do polegar
confirmado: descrição do caso na fonte (sinal clássico autoevidente)
alt: Radiografia cervical em perfil com epiglote espessada em forma de polegar
descricao_fonte: Acute epiglottitis; Lateral view in X-ray imaging. The lateral soft-tissue radiograph reveals the "thumb sign" that indicates a swollen epiglottis, suggestive of epiglottitis. The diagnosis was confirmed on subsequent imaging and laryngoscopy. The patient recovered following treatment with predonine and ceftriaxone .
